summary: Tested Institution Settings (Zoom, Email, Gamification), Gamification system, and Student Dashboard Restricted features. Fixed critical bug where institution_id was missing from login response, preventing StudentDashboardRestricted from rendering. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified all features working correctly.
passed_tests: GET /api/institution/settings - Returns settings object with zoom, email, gamification sections
POST /api/institution/settings/zoom - Saves Zoom configuration
POST /api/institution/settings/email - Saves Email SMTP configuration
POST /api/institution/settings/gamification - Saves gamification settings
GET /api/gamification/profile - Returns student gamification profile with XP, level, streak, badges
GET /api/gamification/leaderboard - Returns institution leaderboard
GET /api/gamification/challenges - Returns weekly challenges (MOCKED with sample data)
GET /api/student/profile - Returns student data with current_exam, exam_access, credits
GET /api/student/upcoming-classes - Returns upcoming live classes
POST /api/institution/settings/zoom/test - Validates Zoom credentials required
POST /api/institution/settings/email/test - Validates SMTP credentials required
POST /api/zoom/meetings/create - Validates Zoom configuration required
UI: Institution Settings page with 3 tabs (Zoom, Email, Gamification)
UI: Zoom tab shows configuration form with Account ID, Client ID, Client Secret
UI: Email tab shows SMTP configuration with presets (Gmail, Outlook, SendGrid, Mailgun)
UI: Gamification tab shows XP rewards, streak settings, leaderboard/badges/challenges toggles
UI: Student Dashboard Restricted shows only assigned exam (IELTS)
UI: Gamification elements (Level, XP, Streak, Daily XP) visible in student dashboard
UI: Weekly Challenges section with progress bars
UI: Achievements & Badges page with 10 badges
UI: Institution Leaderboard showing student rankings

context_for_next_testing_agent: Institution Settings feature fully tested: 1) Zoom tab - configuration form working, test connection validates credentials, 2) Email tab - SMTP configuration with presets working, test email validates credentials, 3) Gamification tab - all settings (XP rewards, streak multiplier, leaderboard/badges/challenges toggles) working. Student Dashboard Restricted working correctly - shows only assigned exam (IELTS for maria@demo.com), gamification elements (Level, XP, Streak), Weekly Challenges, Achievements & Badges, and Institution Leaderboard.

bugs_fixed.issue: Student Dashboard Restricted not rendering - showing full dashboard with all exams instead
bugs_fixed.root_cause: UserResponse model and login/register/me endpoints did not include institution_id field. StudentDashboardRouter checks user.institution_id to decide which dashboard to show.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added institution_id: Optional[str] = None to UserResponse model and included institution_id in login, register, and /auth/me endpoint responses
